InputDebounceCounters.description: Presence and absence tick counters of one debounce state machine (vcu_input_sm_a..e_tick). present_ticks counts consecutive present readings and absent_ticks the absent ones; both are used against small thresholds. Units: ticks of the state machine call rate.

fields.name: present_ticks
fields.description: Ticks in which the qualifier reads present. Saturates at 10000. Above 4 it starts the presence debounce.

fields.name: absent_ticks
fields.description: Ticks in which the qualifier reads absent. Used with the threshold 9 (more than 9 latches the event from the absence state) and the 3 to 19 window for the 7 to 8 transition (probably).
